```yaml
name: NuGet Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "master", "release" ]
    tags: [ "[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [windows-latest, ubuntu-latest]
        include:
          - os: windows-latest
            platform: x64
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            platform: x64

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
      with:
        dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    - name: Determine version
      run: dotnet build SharpCompress.sln /t:determine-version /p:Configuration=Release

    - name: Update version
      run: dotnet build SharpCompress.sln /t:update-version /p:Configuration=Release

    - name: Build
      run: dotnet build SharpCompress.sln /p:Configuration=Release --no-restore

    - name: Test
      run: dotnet test SharpCompress.sln /p:Configuration=Release --no-build

    - name: Push to NuGet
      if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/release' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/'))
      run: dotnet build SharpCompress.sln /t:push-to-nuget /p:Configuration=Release /p:NuGetApiKey=${{ secrets.NUGET_API_KEY }} --no-build
      env:
        NUGET_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NUGET_API_KEY }}
```
